headline: Atlassian warns of critical file-access flaw in Data Center products
summary: Atlassian warned of a critical file-access vulnerability, CVE-2026-21589, affecting its self-hosted Data Center products including Jira, Confluence and Bitbucket, telling customers action is required.

claims.statement: Atlassian is warning of a critical vulnerability allowing arbitrary file access in its self-hosted Data Center products, including Confluence, Jira and Bitbucket.

sources.quote: Atlassian warns of critical file access flaw in its datacenter products

Atlassian is warning customers of a critical vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2026-21589, that can be exploited for arbitrary file-access in multiple self-hosted Data Center products, including Confluence, Jira, and Bitbucket.

claims.statement: Atlassian told users that action is required to address the flaw.
